result.line: Not an EOA: unverified shared executor (22,852 bytes, nonce 1, 0 ETH); only a hard-coded whitelist of ~15 EOA searchers may call its entry 0x45499ab0 (control: fresh addr reverts 0x8fd00e8e, allowlisted sender reaches body 0x6697928b). Job: Aave v3 liquidator / Compound v3 auction buyer - 22 ledger events in 6 days = 3.7/day whole contract, gross 5-12% of debt (74k USD debt over 20 liqs; 0x992510b8 paid 5,692 USDC, took 3.4626 WETH=6,350, +658) = 620-1,430 USD/day over 15 senders (~40-95 each); gas 0.62-49.7 USD/call (median 13, 0.61-40 gwei), WETH 1,834.
